headline: OKX Spot Sellers Lead Buyers By 365.582 Bitcoin, Up From 103.463 Bitcoin, As Taker Flow Turns Sell-Side
narrative: Aggressive sellers on OKX spot bitcoin outran aggressive buyers by 365.582 bitcoin over 24 hours, up from a 103.463 bitcoin lead that still ranked balanced at the 36.2 percentile of the last 30 days. The same window now sits at the 17.2 percentile, sell-side leaning, which means aggressive sell volume controls the OKX spot taker pipe. Bitcoin long-short account ratios rose to 1.76 from 1.68 and to the 90.0 percentile from 82.9, which that pipe reads as crowded long while the spot taker pipe is selling.
author: jordan
